hero.title:
Product Owner
with a technical stack
hero.sub: I connect business, data and technology. I work with product, marketing and development teams to ship improvements that measure their own impact.

work.title: Work
work.intro: Real cases with context, decisions and measured results.

about.title: About
about.intro: Senior Product Owner with 8 years of experience in eCommerce and digital marketplaces.
about.bio: I started as a web developer and moved to the product side nearly a decade ago. Today I work at the intersection of business, data and technology: I understand what the technical team needs, what the business requires, and how to measure it.
about.q1: I translate complex technical requirements into business language
about.q2: I design measurement strategies before shipping any feature
about.q3: Coordinated teams of up to 12 people in cross-functional projects
about.q4: Real technical background: HTML, CSS, SQL, GTM, GA4

process.title: Process
process.intro: How I work in practice: from problem detection to measured result.
process.step1Desc: Data analysis, stakeholder interviews, dependency mapping. The real problem is rarely the stated problem.
process.step2Desc: Data-driven hypotheses. I identify root causes before proposing solutions to avoid wasted work.
process.step3Desc: Minimum viable scope with maximum impact. I define success metrics before writing the first ticket.
process.step4Desc: Alignment between Dev, Marketing, Data and Business. Dependency management and status communication.
process.step5Desc: Pre/post protocol. Audits before each release. Results inform the next iteration.
